overview_description.description:
Bluerizon is a software and online data-science platform that powering the intelligence layer of global markets to deliver actionable insights to businesses, consumers and retail traders. It allows its user to grow and scale their approach to the global markets by helping them making smarter, faster and better decisions. Also, It provides a large library of online courses, AI driven price predictions, analysis, normalised data, automation and many more.

Bluerizon was launched in 2022 with a mission to create a financial freedom ecosystem for the world and dual-headquartered in Menlo Park, California and Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
